Lightning Talk: Eight Consteval Queens and Compile-Time Printing - Sagnik Bhattacharya - CppCon 2025
---

In this talk we will first convert a template metaprogram that solves the 8-queen problem into a consteval compile-time program. Then we will explore ways to make gcc and clang print at compile time.
---

Work at Hudson River Trading (HRT): https://tinyurl.com/safxfctf
---

Sagnik is a software engineer at IMC Trading, where they contribute to the hardware team’s low-latency systems and networking solutions. Their work focuses mainly on C++ with some Python. Sagnik earned both a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in EECS/CS from UC Berkeley.
